title: Support for Global Education Programme for ITE and Polytechnic Students to Gain Regional Exposure
what_it_is: Support for Global Education Programme for ITE and Polytechnic Students to Gain Regional Exposure

sections.label: Opportunity Fund overseas exposure trips
sections.summary: In 2018 about 3,500 polytechnic and ITE students benefited from the Opportunity Fund for overseas exposure trips, a 33% increase from two years ago.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2018, about 3,500 polytechnic and ITE students benefited from the Opportunity Fund for overseas exposure trips.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This is an increase of about 33% from two years ago.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In addition, MOE and other Government agencies also provide support and funding that encourage our students to venture into the region for longer overseas internships.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: These include the Enterprise Singapore's Young Talent Programme which will soon be subsumed under the upcoming Global Ready Talent Programme and MOE's Global Innovation Alliance Innovators Academy programme, which targets internships in overseas startups.

sections.label: Polytechnic and ITE overseas participation
sections.summary: About half of polytechnic students and more than a quarter of ITE students have participated in overseas exposure trips.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Today, about half of our polytechnic students and more than a quarter of our ITE students have participated in overseas exposure trips.

sections.label: Overseas exposure and Global Education Programme
sections.summary: 40% of polytechnic and ITE students participate in overseas exposure programmes, and ITE disbursed about $700,000 under the Global Education Programme for needy students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Today, 40% of our polytechnic and ITE students participate in overseas exposure programmes, compared to about 30% six years ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: To the first question, in 2018, as far as the Global Education Programme is concerned, ITE disbursed about $700,000 under the Global Education Programme in additional funding and assistance for needy students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: About 4,000 students benefited under the Global Education Programme.

sections.label: Opportunity Fund Grant funding increase
sections.summary: MOE disbursed an average of $2 million yearly to ITE and $5 million to the polytechnics, and increased funding to $3 million and $6 million respectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Between the year 2016 and 2018, each year, MOE disbursed through this Opportunity Fund Grant – it is a scheme to help our students from lower-income households – an average of $2 million to ITE for the year 2016 to 2018, that is, $2 million a year, and $5 million for the five polytechnics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We have increased the funding to $3 million for the ITEs, from $2 million to $3 million, and for the polytechnics, from $5 million to $6 million.
